div.head: Wl art retr 3
div.ab: Uolumus autem et firmiter precipimus, ut omnes homines, quos nobiscum adduximus, aut post nos uenerint, sint sub protectione et in pace nostra per uniuersum regnum predictum.
Volumus autem et firmiter praecipimus, ut omnes homines quos nobiscum adduximus aut post nos venerint sint sub protectione et in pace nostra per universum regnum praedictum.
We desire likewise and firmly enjoin, that all the men, whom we brought with us or who have come after us, shall enjoy the benefits of protection throughout the whole of the aforesaid realm.
div.note: Wl art 3; Wl art 3.1; Wl art 3.2
